    StartersHalftime crispy orange chicken bitesCrispy chicken thigh in a sticky orange ginger sauce, sesame on topHow to make it600g chicken thigh filletssoy sauce, to taste70g cornflour1 L vegetable oil3 oranges2 tbsp honey1 tbsp rice vinegar1 knob ginger1 garlic clovesesame seeds, to taste2 spring onionsCut the chicken thigh into bite-sized pieces, toss with the soy, then in the cornflour.Fry in batches in oil at 180°C for 4 to 5 minutes until crisp.Simmer the juice of the oranges with the zest of one of them, the soy, the honey, the rice vinegar, the grated ginger and the garlic clove for 5 minutes, then thicken with the cornflour in water.Toss the chicken through and top with sesame and spring onion.Phil's vitamin shop granola barsOat, almond and cranberry bars with honey, peanut butter and dark chocolateHow to make it250g rolled oats80g almonds50g pepitas120g honey100g peanut butter50g butter50g brown sugar80g dried cranberries80g dark chocolateHeat the oven to 170°C.Toast the rolled oats, the chopped almonds and the pepitas on a tray for 10 minutes.Warm the honey, the peanut butter, the butter and the brown sugar until smooth.Stir into the oats with the dried cranberries and a pinch of salt.Press firmly into a lined 20 x 30cm tin and bake 20 minutes.Cool, scatter with the melted dark chocolate and cut into bars once set.Mini Italian meatball subsDon't forget the meatballs! Keep passing to the Italians.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsApprentice butcher Italian sausage rollsGrilled fennel sausage, charred capsicum, onion and provolone in a rollHow to make it8 Italian fennel sausages2 red capsicums2 brown onionsvegetable oil, to taste8 long rolls8 slices of provolone1 jar hot giardinieraSlice the red capsicums and the onions and cook in the oil over medium-high heat for 12 minutes until soft and charred.Grill the Italian fennel sausages on a medium barbecue for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until cooked through.Split the long rolls, toast, and lay a slice of provolone in.Add a sausage, the capsicum and onion and a spoon of chopped hot giardiniera or pickled chillies.SweetsCoffee shop biscottiTwice-baked almond biscotti, crisp and made for dunkingHow to make it250g plain flour200g caster sugar1 tsp baking powder3 eggs150g almondsMix the plain flour, the sugar, the baking powder, the eggs and the whole almonds into a dough.Shape the logs and bake at 180°C for 25 minutes.Cool 10 minutes, slice thinly and bake 10 minutes more until crisp.DrinksPhil's quadruple-shot mochaStrong espresso and chocolate milk topped with whipped cream and shavingsHow to make it100g dark chocolate2 tbsp sugar800ml milkespresso coffee beans, to taste100ml thickened creamchocolate-coated coffee beans, to tasteMelt the chopped dark chocolate with the sugar in a saucepan with the milk, whisking until smooth.Add more milk and heat until steaming, whisking until frothy.Pull the shots of espresso.Pour the shots into each of the big mugs and top with the chocolate milk.Whip the cream and spoon on, then add chocolate shavings and the chocolate-coated coffee beans.Decaf is allowed.Fresh orange and carrot juiceNo caffeine.
